rules.message: Fix the ruff finding instead of silencing it. The existing markers are the baseline of legacy code and only go down.
Fix the mypy error instead of ignoring it. Each `# type: ignore[...]  # faker-kit baseline` is legacy code waiting for a type; remove it when you touch that line.

Read GitHub with Gh.api_page / Gh.api_json (REST, conditional ETag). `gh issue` and `gh pr` list, view, status, and checks are GraphQL-backed and fail in cloud sessions. Writes (create, edit, close, comment, merge) stay allowed.
